title: Service Recovery After Repeated Billing Corrections - Ostomy Supply Program
content:
When the Ostomy Supply Program corrects an expedited shipping charge posted in error against a shipment Larkfield sent expedited at no charge, a repeat service-recovery part follows the billing corrections already posted on the program in the last 12 months (posting date fewer than 12 whole calendar months before today).

| Billing corrections already posted in the last 12 months | Repeat part |
|---|---|
| Two or more | USD 10.00 (the larger repeat recovery) |
| Exactly one | USD 5.00 (the smaller repeat recovery) |
| None | Nothing |

This part adds to the whole charge.

**Cases (hypothetical).** No earlier correction: nothing. One correction posted 3 months ago: USD 5.00. Two corrections within the 12 months: USD 10.00. One correction posted 14 months ago only: nothing.
